Relive the most intense, high-stakes drama as we watch Alicia (Julianna Margulies) clash with client Jonas Stern (Kevin Conway) as he refuses to use his dementia diagnosis to win his DUI case. Meanwhile, Peter (Chris Noth) faces a massive betrayal when Gerald (Terry Kinney) reveals he is wearing a hidden wire.
